summary: End-to-end backend (pytest, 23/23 pass) and frontend (Playwright) testing for CampusOne across all 3 roles. All major user journeys verified: login (all roles + wrong-password inline error), navbar+bell+mark-all-read, admin data/stats/timetable/events/leave-approval, student timetable+CSV download+assignment submit ('Turned in' badge shown)+classroom Jitsi meeting room with mic/video/screen/end-call controls+doubt chat (send/attach/save transcript/close), teacher assignment creation+see student threads+reply+leave apply. Two-sided doubt chat verified. Seeded data (Diya's submission, Meera half-day leave, TechFest event) present. One backend bug fixed by testing agent (POST /api/admin/rooms 500 due to MongoDB _id not popped).

issues: Jitsi meet.jit.si XMPP moderator errors in console (expected in headless preview; not blocking)

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 958 lines — consider splitting into routers per resource (auth/timetable/assignments/classes/doubts/leaves/admin/events) for maintainability (>700 line guideline).

add_room (line ~707) was returning the raw insert dict containing MongoDB ObjectId '_id' causing 500 on POST /api/admin/rooms. Testing agent added doc.pop('_id', None). Audit all other insert_one paths for the same pattern (most already pop _id).

Endpoint contract inconsistency: /api/assignments and /api/doubts/threads/{tid}/messages use multipart Form fields while other write endpoints use JSON Pydantic bodies. Consider documenting this or unifying — trips up client tooling.
CORS uses os.environ.get('CORS_ORIGINS', '*').split(',') defaulting to '*' — acceptable for demo but should be locked to explicit origins in prod.
seed_data_creation: Created transient TEST_-prefixed rows via API tests (assignments, rooms, faculty, students, events, leaves, doubt threads); most cleaned up. Ended TEST_pytest_asg assignments remain in DB (visible in teacher UI) — harmless.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest -n auto compatible). Backend URL from frontend/.env: https://roster-hub-129.preview.emergentagent.com. Admin POST /api/admin/rooms bug already fixed. If retesting, existing TEST_pytest_asg assignments and TEST_R* rooms may exist — use unique names.
rca of the issue: POST /api/admin/rooms returned 500 because add_room() inserted a doc into MongoDB (which mutates it to add ObjectId _id) and returned it directly to FastAPI's JSON encoder, which cannot serialize ObjectId. Reproduction: authenticated admin POST /api/admin/rooms {name,type,capacity}. Fix: doc.pop('_id', None) before return (applied).
